direction: Simplify the policy around strategic intents instead of adding another specific tactical instruction.

causal_evidence.failure_shape: The planner was live, but an exception-heavy executor mixed alliance retries, build cadences, conversion escapes, collapse guards, and target-specific rules beneath a two-intent plan.
causal_evidence.counterexample: One loss built four silos and 23 bombs and still scored zero, so another isolated action-count rule is not justified.

causal_hypothesis: A small intent vocabulary with one generic legal-action scorer will preserve strategic coherence across the episode better than accumulated branch-specific rules. The model owns the desired outcome and optional rival; deterministic code owns only validation, no-harm safety, legal-action scoring, and execution.

directive_shape.targetID: null for expand, fortify, and defend; exact visible rival ID for ally and pressure

candidate.single_architectural_change: When POLICY_ENGINE=intent-core, bypass the legacy parent selector and score safe offered actions directly by their alignment with the active intent. No map fingerprint, named opponent, fixed build order, retry cadence, nuke threshold, or bespoke recovery arm enters the intent executor.
preserved: high-risk avoidance when a safer option exists
absolute no-harm protection for K1Z Mickey Mouse
background planner refresh and timeout handling

red_fixtures: Under expand, the exact parent spends a legal decision on a coalition request while safe neutral land is offered; intent-core selects neutral land.
Under defend with current pressure, the exact parent can continue a proactive social action; intent-core selects a safe defensive or retaliatory action.
Under ally or pressure, intent-core never substitutes a different rival for the directive's exact target ID.
No intent can select a harmful action against K1Z Mickey Mouse.
local_pass_bar: red tests fail on exact parent and pass on candidate
all five intents reach through hash-bound fixtures
zero illegal actions, fallback, degradation, unexplained holds, rejects, unresolved harmful targets, or K1Z harm
exact linux/amd64 image matches committed source
full suite adds no candidate-related failure
hosted_guard: No upload follows until local mechanism and pre-upload RCI pass. No league submission or champion change follows until hosted 4/4, separate regression 20/20, and final RCI pass.
